text: Done in ScalaFIM d443cd76d250f08172379452a2a159761b074b4f. DomainFactory stateless (no process-wide registry, registeredCount removed); independent restores align via checked DomainAlignment; explicit DomainRegistry for shared scopes. Identity fixes: dataset keyed by persistent GridId + length-prefixed dataset id (was identityHashCode), ephemeral without persistent grid; radial full grid, surface parcels, spatial loci ephemeral (size-only / label-only / id+size keys removed). locus-data facade (package.scala aliases, MapEvidence) deleted; callers use locus4s names. Tests: DomainIdentityProbeSuite (independent restore, alignment+transport, order, unique selection vs [2,0,2], wrong id/size rejection, explicit registry scope, ephemeral), dataset template-world reload/geometry/dataset/run-length/structural-collision tests, connectivity node/vectorization order, AxisRef permuted-key locus rejection. Gates: scalafimCompileAll + examplesCompile warning-clean; all 49 JVM test tasks green; JS green for locus-data, connectivity, threshold, latent, archive-interop, dataset, surface, spatial, atlas, mvpa, mvpa-spatial, foundation, mvpa-dataset, model, fit, mvpa-fit, fmri-workflow, dataset-zarr. Independent Opus review: no blockers; majors (vacuous tests, label/id-only keys, stale locus-data README) fixed. Public API: EvidenceError.LocusIdentityFailure removed (no downstream refs); dataset timeSpace/fullVoxelSpace and latent fullGridSpace now FiniteDomain; surface semanticKey is locus4s.DomainId. Deferred (decision note): Parcellation/Searchlight -> locus4s PartialSurjection/NeighborhoodSystem with U3/U5 consumers; atlas AtlasRealization network key is labels-only (A1 scope).
